value: All stories in the book must be written in first person. All client/company names must be anonymized. Jesse noticed the 13-to-8 headcount shift over time via EOS scorecard and Stripe/financials (not a single moment). Donna is a real name that needs anonymization.

Compound does NOT have on-site implementers like EOS. Compound has: (1) a coaching program with weekly coaching calls where members ask questions and get feedback, (2) the Compound Bench — a set of AI agents and skills available to clients/members that help them walk through the Compound Sprint process, build artifacts, and work independently. Coach provides human support, Bench provides agent support. Coach is remote, not on-site. Members do most work themselves.
